title: Soukuu no Tsubasa: Gotha World
overview: Set in the aerial world "Gotha World", this is the great epic story that depicts the fight between the private garrison where the main character belongs and the pirate guild! After deciding operations for all units for both allies and enemies, the "Personal Time System" in action will greatly influence the outcome of the battle! Predicting the enemy 's actions, making strategy plans and carry out the actions in battle will be the key to victory!
